label: PostgreSQL integration test
info: Creates, tests, and removes its own PostgreSQL table. Covers query templates, dynamic queries, numeric and named parameters, split results, and backpressure. Use the Inject node for manual testing or POST /postgresql-test/run for automation.

name: Ready
Start test
Reset and seed table
Assert setup
Named parameter SELECT
query:
SELECT id, value, processed
FROM node_red_postgresql_test
WHERE id BETWEEN $minimum AND $maximum
ORDER BY id;

name: Assert non-split result
Template + split SELECT
Assert split batch
Tick or verify
Verify table
query:
SELECT
	COUNT(*)::integer AS total,
	COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE processed)::integer AS processed,
	SUM(value)::integer AS value_sum
FROM node_red_postgresql_test;

PASS
